test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Danny is the __better__ basketball player in the team.
solution:
The correct answer is "best".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There is a use of** "the" **before the underlined **adjective**.
 
• The** superlative degree** of a verb should be used after the article **"the"**.
 
• When describing something that is at the upper or lower extent of quality, superlative adjectives are utilized (the tallest, the smallest, the fastest, the highest).
 
• The sentence structure will be **Noun (subject) + verb + the + superlative adjective + noun (object)**.

So the correct sentence will be **Danny is the best__**** basketball player in the team**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Good** is the **positive degree** but it does not use after **"the"**.
 
• **Most** is an **adverb** and also a superlative degree of** "more"** which is an adverb. This will not be making sense before basketball.
 
• **Gooder** is the **comparative degree **of the verb "good".
